examples.summary: List the elements on screen
Include every view, such as to find one without accessibility information

name: describe

parameters.name: all
parameters.summary: Include every visible view, even without accessibility information.

summary: Returns the tree of visible Views and Jetpack Compose semantics nodes in the app's windows, with their identifier, label, value, traits, frame in screen dp and whether touches reach them. Each has a ref, such as e12, that other commands take to target it. Containers without accessibility information are left out unless `all` is set.
